scope: Actual native game world, production HUD, third-person camera and Mara; scripted inputs routed through real Session/Realm; isolated solo save.
setup: Default fresh solo spawn; camera zoom set to4.25m, pitch0.15rad and orbit0.35rad. Physical-input signal disconnected only in harness; Session.send_input supplies deterministic controls. Abilities are sent through the actual HUD. No Avatar.apply_state calls, synthetic poses, player teleport or direct action-state injection.
timing: Godot --fixed-fps20; ordinary production physics and frame callbacks; playback encoded at20fps.
visual_review: All six refreshed native screenshots inspected: running, jump, roll, Iron Vow, Mooncleave and return to idle. The real town geometry, third-person camera and production HUD remain visible.
The original accepted Mara model is used throughout. All 320 captured frames report the actor visible.
This is fixed-timestep offline rendering; encoded 20 fps is not a real-time performance benchmark.
refresh: Final frozen production motion capture including accepted turn-entry and action-entry foot-anchor fixes. Source hashes verified unchanged from launch through capture completion.
